finalText:
Build's clean now — exits 0.

Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage of `build.js`:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the new bundler passes options as `{ retryCount }`, but `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries`, which was `undefined` and threw on `.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but `isBackoffEnabled` only handled explicit `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. Simplified it to `flags.backoffEnabled === true`, which treats `undefined` as disabled.

The rest of the ~950-line wall (`WARN DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, etc., plus the `dedupe:` spam) is just deprecation noise from the bumped packages, not build-breaking — that's expected and unrelated to the crash.
